title: Converging Richtmyer-Meshkov (RM) instability on the magnetically driven Decel platform
description: Ellison benchmark 3. A magnetically driven cylindrical liner (piston) launches a shock into a liquid-deuterium working fluid and into an on-axis rod carrying a pre-imposed sinusoidal perturbation, producing a Richtmyer-Meshkov instability in convergent geometry. The simulation must quantitatively reproduce the RM spike-amplitude growth (the quantitative anchor for #119).

primary_source.paper: A novel, magnetically driven convergent Richtmyer-Meshkov platform

setup.target: on-axis rod with a pre-imposed sinusoidal perturbation
